question: Sophia has a collection of 300 marbles. she uses one-third of them to fill a jar and is asked to put the rest away. she puts all the leftover marbles back in their container, except for 8 missing marbles that she can't find. how many marbles are in the container at the end?
A baker has 60 cupcakes. a third of the cupcakes are chocolate, but only half of the chocolate ones have sprinkles. how many of the cupcakes with sprinkles are also chocolate?
In a garden, there are roses and tulips. there are 15 more roses than tulips, and together they make up a total of 45 flowers. how many roses are in the garden?

Sophia and liam went to a bookstore. novels cost $10 each, and comic books cost $5 each. sophia bought 3 novels and 2 comic books. liam bought 1 novel and 4 comic books. how much did their purchase cost?

In a library, there are fiction and non-fiction books. there are 20 more fiction books than non-fiction books, and together they make up a total of 70 books. how many fiction books are in the library?
Mark has 3 pairs of shoes and decides to buy 2 more. each pair costs $50, but he gets a discount of $10 per pair for buying multiple pairs. how much does mark spend on the new pairs of shoes?

Lily is organizing a book club meeting. she plans to provide each member with 3 books: one fiction, one non-fiction, and one poetry book. the fiction book costs $15, the non-fiction book costs twice as much as the fiction book, and the poetry book costs half as much as the non-fiction book. if there are 8 members in the book club, how much will lily spend on all the books?
A library has 500 books in its collection. it receives a donation of 150 more books, and then lends out 120 books to patrons. how many books are left in the library's collection?

Sarah and her friends are participating in a charity walkathon. for every mile they walk, they raise $5 for their cause. they walked 4 miles on the first day and 6 miles on the second day. how much money did they raise altogether?
Emily is three times as old as ethan and sarah's age is one-third the age of ethan's. if ethan is 9 years old, what is the difference between the age of sarah and emily?
In a classroom, there are boys and girls. there are 10 more boys than girls, and together they make up a total of 50 students. how many boys are in the classroom?
A farmer has 80 chickens. half of the chickens are hens, and a quarter of the hens lay eggs every day. how many egg-laying hens does the farmer have?
Olivia went to a toy store. dolls cost $15 each, and action figures cost $8 each. olivia bought 4 dolls and 3 action figures. how much did her purchase cost?

Emily wants to buy a dress she saw in a store. she saved money for 4 months. her friend heard that she was excited and gave her $30 as a gift towards the dress. if she paid $200 in total for the dress, how much money did she save per month?
A gardener has 120 plants. a quarter of the plants are roses, but only a third of the roses have thorns. how many of the thorny plants are also roses?

Sophia is organizing a charity event and plans to buy gift bags for the attendees. she needs 20 small bags and 30 large bags. if a small bag costs $5 each and a large bag costs three times as much as a small bag, how much money does sophia spend on the gift bags?
A baker has 120 muffins. one-third of the muffins are blueberry, and half of the blueberry muffins have chocolate chips. how many blueberry muffins with chocolate chips does the baker have?
A farmer has 80 acres of land. he plants corn on half of the land and wheat on a quarter of the remaining area. if he decides to plant soybeans on the rest, how many acres are planted with soybeans?
A florist has 50 roses. a quarter of the roses are red, but only half of the red ones have thorns. how many of the roses with thorns are also red?

Tom is organizing a music club meeting. he plans to provide each member with 3 items: one album, one concert ticket, and one poster. the album costs $20, the concert ticket costs twice as much as the album, and the poster costs half as much as the concert ticket. if there are 10 members in the music club, how much will tom spend on all the items?
A chef has 90 cookies. one-fourth of the cookies are oatmeal, and two-thirds of the oatmeal cookies have raisins. how many oatmeal cookies with raisins does the chef have?

A farmer has 50 chickens and decides to sell some eggs. each chicken lays 3 eggs per day, but the farmer accidentally breaks a dozen eggs while collecting them. if he sells all the remaining eggs at $0.25 each, how much money does he make in one day?

A school is organizing a field trip. they rent enough buses to accommodate all the students, then rent additional buses for teachers and chaperones. each bus can hold 40 people. if there are 320 students and each teacher needs their own seat, how many buses does the school need if there are 8 teachers going on the trip?

A baker makes 100 cookies every day. he sells half of them in the morning and a quarter of them in the afternoon. if he gives away 10 cookies to his friends, how many cookies does he have left at the end of the day?

A baker has 60 loaves of bread and decides to sell some slices. each loaf is sliced into 10 pieces, but the baker accidentally burns a dozen slices while baking them. if he sells all the remaining slices at $0.50 each, how much money does he make in one day?

A chef is preparing a meal for a party. he needs 15 pounds of chicken, which costs $4 per pound, and 10 pounds of vegetables, which cost $2 per pound. additionally, he spends $50 on spices and seasonings. if the total expense for the meal is divided equally among 20 guests, how much does each guest pay?
Emily is organizing her art supplies and has 300 paintbrushes. if 25% of the brushes are damaged and she sets them aside as unusable, calculate the total number of usable paintbrushes.
Tom has 12 books. he has twice as many books as lisa. how many books do tom and lisa have together?
A farmer has 4 fields and wants to plant corn in each field. each field requires 3 bags of seeds, and one bag costs $5. how much does the farmer spend on seeds for all his fields?

A farmer has 100 apples and decides to sell them at a market. each apple is sold for $0.75, but during transportation, he loses 15 apples due to damage. if he sells all the remaining apples, how much money does he make?
A farmer has 120 apple trees. a quarter of the trees are red apples, and only a third of the red apple trees produce large apples. how many of the trees producing large apples are red apple trees?

Sarah plans to host a movie night for her friends. she has 3 different genres of movies, with 5 films in each genre. if she wants to show one film from each genre and also add an extra comedy film, how many total films will be shown during the movie night?
Sarah practices the piano every afternoon, 4 days a week for 45 minutes. she doubles her practice time on fridays and saturdays. how many minutes does sarah spend practicing in one week?

A baker makes 12 loaves of bread every hour, while his assistant makes 9 loaves per hour. if the assistant took a one-hour break, what is the difference between the number of loaves they made after 6 hours?

Sarah is planning a road trip. she needs to rent a car for 5 days, which costs $40 per day, and spend $100 on gas. additionally, she plans to spend $50 on food during the trip. if her total budget for the trip is $400, how much money will she have left after covering all expenses?
A bakery has 100 cupcakes. they sell 30 chocolate cupcakes, 25 vanilla cupcakes, and the rest are strawberry and lemon cupcakes in equal amounts. how many lemon cupcakes are there?

A bookstore sells novels and magazines. each novel costs $15, while each magazine costs $8. if a customer buys 6 novels and 10 magazines, how much more does the customer spend on novels than on magazines?
A farmer buys a new tractor for $25,000. he pays $10,000 upfront and covers the remaining balance by paying $750 each month. how many months will it take to fully pay off the tractor?
A school has 300 students enrolled. it admits 50 new students and then 20 students graduate early. how many students are currently enrolled in the school?
A gardener has 80 tulips. a third of the tulips are yellow, but only half of the yellow ones have spots. how many of the tulips with spots are also yellow?
Sarah is planning a garden party. she needs to set up tables for her guests. each table can seat 8 people, and she expects 64 guests. how many tables does sarah need to set up?
There were 60 birds in a park and twice as many squirrels. if alice spots 10 birds and half the squirrels climb trees, how many more squirrels than birds are there in the park now?
Sarah owns 4 boutiques, her first boutique sells 15 dresses, her second boutique sells 25 dresses, and her third boutique sells 35 dresses per day. how many dresses do her 4 boutiques sell per week?

Oliver is planning a party and needs to buy drinks. he currently has 15 bottles of soda but wants to have enough for each of the 40 guests to have 2 bottles. how many additional bottles does oliver need to purchase?
Lily has a collection of 120 stamps. she decides to give one-third of her collection to her friend and then buys 15 more stamps to add to her collection. how many stamps does lily have now?

A gardener is planting trees in a park. each tree requires 3 liters of water per day. if there are 12 trees and the gardener plans to water them for 10 days, how many liters of water will be needed in total?
A chef has 60 eggs. he uses a quarter of the eggs to make omelets, and half of the remaining eggs to bake cakes. how many eggs does he have left after making omelets and baking cakes?
A baker makes 40 cupcakes, and the number of cupcakes he makes increases by 25% every month. how many cupcakes will the baker have made in four months?

Lucas has 3 boxes of chocolates, each containing 12 pieces. he gives away a quarter of the chocolates to his coworkers and then half of the remaining chocolates to his family. lucas eats 5 chocolates himself. how many chocolates does lucas have left?

A chef is preparing a meal for a party. each guest needs 3 appetizers, and there are twice as many guests as the number of tables. if there are 8 tables, how many appetizers does the chef need to prepare?

A toy store sells dolls and action figures. each doll costs $12, while each action figure costs $7. if a customer buys 5 dolls and 8 action figures, how much more does the customer spend on dolls than on action figures?
Jessica is 5 cm taller than sarah. sarah is 2 cm taller than emma. if emma is 145 cm tall, how many centimeters tall is jessica?
A baker has 240 cupcakes. he decides to give half of his cupcakes to a charity event and then bakes 30 more cupcakes to add to his collection. how many cupcakes does the baker have now?
A library has 500 books. a third of the books are fiction, and half of the fiction books are mystery novels. how many mystery novels does the library have?
A farmer plants 100 apple trees, and the number of trees he plants increases by 30% every year. how many apple trees will the farmer have planted in three years?
A bakery sells a third of its products in the morning, half of its products in the afternoon, and the rest in the evening. they sold 60 products today. how many products were sold in the evening?
Jessica has 15 pencils. she has three times as many pencils as mark. how many pencils do jessica and mark have together?

John had a collection of stamps. he gave away 1/3 of them to his friend in january, 1/6 of them to another friend in february, and then sold 50 stamps in march. after these transactions, he still had 120 stamps left. how many stamps did john have initially?

A library has a collection of 300 books. they decide to donate one-fifth of their collection to a local school and then acquire 50 more books for the library. how many books does the library have now?
Emma has 5 times as many marbles as jake. if jake gives away 12 marbles and emma loses 15, they will have the same number of marbles left. how many marbles does jake have initially?
A chef has 120 eggs and uses a third of them to make omelets. he then uses half of the remaining eggs for baking cakes. how many eggs does he have left?
